name: Haus Pinnistor
beschreibung: The Haus Pinnistor is peacefully located on Pinnisweg in the renowned holiday destination of Neustift im Stubaital, right at the gateway to the romantic Pinnis Valley. Beautifully decorated in a Tyrolean alpine cottage style featuring natural timber, the guest rooms include en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, and balconies framing scenic views of the prominent Elferspitze and the Stubai Alps. In the morning, a hearty breakfast packed with local valley specialities is served. The lower terminal of the Elferbahnen cable cars, famed for winter tobogganing and summer paragliding, along with Neustift's town centre, is only a short walk away. In winter, the complimentary ski bus quickly transports skiers to Austria's largest glacier ski domain, the Stubai Glacier.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy guesthouse on Pinnisweg in Neustift im Stubaital featuring traditional rooms and easy access to the Elfer lifts.
